email.subject1: a signal play for GTM Buddy
email.body1:
Ron, saw GTM Buddy repositioning around revenue activation for the agentic era of sales.

A pivot that sharp usually puts more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before the new story lands, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for GTM Buddy off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ron, quick follow-up for GTM Buddy.

With a new category narrative, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and recovery eats the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GTM Buddy needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.
email.body3:
Ron, last bit of proof for GTM Buddy.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how GTM Buddy's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ron, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters during a repositioning, and I know shifting the whole motion to a new story is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I will tailor it to GTM Buddy either way.
